title: Profile upload to Medtronic error when having too many rows in basals
symptom: After a profile change, the profile was not getting uploaded to the pump with a noisy alarm. The user found that the profile was too big (added few rows to basals) and managed to recover by reducing the number of rows in basals to 8.
cause: The thread does not definitively establish a root cause. The user speculates it might be a limitation of the pump or OrangeLink, and a commenter suggests it could be a communication problem with the RileyLink clone causing timeouts during the long command transmission.
fix: The user recovered by reducing the number of rows in basals to 8. No other resolution is stated.
evidence_quote: I found out that I have made the profile too big (added few rows to basals) and managed to recover by reducing number of rows in basals to 8.
